claim_ceiling: The selected basis is a finite-support, query-specific licensing basis, not the unique true causal context.
Discovery sufficiency does not imply held-out transport; P2 explicitly falsifies the selected portable field on new contexts.
Architecture descriptors are secondary diagnostics and cannot convert this failed portable field into a PASS.
Berserk P:EMPTY means no additional portable coordinate beyond F0 on finite discovery support, not context-free universal causation.
Unseen context signatures imply abstention, not non-causality.
Covered agreement at individual records does not override the eight held-out contradictions or the mixed cell.
No transport beyond the frozen books, source commits, TT-history procedure, Threads=1, Hash=1 MiB and 80k-node measurement search is authorized.
No post-hoc cardinality expansion, engine/FEN/key/address conditioning, learned identifier, or outcome-tuned threshold may repair P2.
No chess strategy, cognition, human intent or population prevalence claim is authorized.
Toolkit v3 reproducibility proves executable replay of the P2 certificate pipeline, not scientific transport.
